recentItems.title: The Fan Controlled Show - Real Professionals!
recentItems.description: The Fan Controlled Show is the flagship show for all things Fan Controlled Sports. This week we are only 2 short days away from the FIRST EVER Fan Controlled Baseball game! The Oakland Ballers of the Pioneer League will be allowing us the fans to call everything from pitches to steals, jerseys and concession specials! It's going to be a legendary night in the history of baseball and it's all LIVE in the Control App!

recentItems.title: The Fan Controlled Show - THEEEE BALLEEEEEEEERS
recentItems.description: The Fan Controlled Show is the weekly flagship show dedicated to all things Fan Controlled Sports! This week we welcome Bryan Carmel, founder of the Oakland Ballers and Tyler Petersen, the lead play-by-play announcer! They'll break down this season, just how important the Ballers are to Oakland and play a little Oakland Trivia!
